questions.question: What warning does Dumbledore give Harry about the Mirror of Erised?
questions.answer: It does not do to dwell on dreams and forget to live.
choices: It does not do to dwell on dreams and forget to live.
It does not do to dwell on glory and forget your friends.
It does not do to fear death and forget to hope.
It does not do to trust the mirror and forget the Stone.
questions.note: The line is 'It does not do to dwell on dreams and forget to live, remember that.'

questions.question: Dumbledore tells Harry that our what show who we truly are, far more than our abilities?
questions.note: End of the second film. He is talking about Harry asking the Sorting Hat not to put him in Slytherin.

questions.question: What does Dumbledore say can be found even in the darkest of times, if one only remembers to turn on the light?
questions.note: He says it in Prisoner of Azkaban. The film uses the line as its opening idea.

questions.question: What does Molly Weasley shout at Bellatrix before she kills her?
questions.note: Great Hall, Battle of Hogwarts. Bellatrix had turned on Ginny.

questions.question: Snape says there will be no foolish wand-waving or what in his Potions class?
questions.note: First Potions lesson. He goes on about bottling fame, brewing glory, and putting a stopper in death.

questions.question: What page does Snape tell the first-years to turn to?
questions.note: He says it in the first film, before anyone has found the page.

questions.question: What threat does Draco repeat when things do not go his way?
questions.answer: My father will hear about this.
choices: My father will hear about this.
questions.note: He starts saying it in the first film and never really stops.

questions.question: What little cough does Umbridge use when she wants the room's attention?
questions.note: She does it at the staff table and in the middle of Dumbledore's start-of-term speech.

questions.question: What does Dumbledore ask Harry when the Goblet of Fire gives his name?
questions.answer: Harry, did you put your name in the Goblet of Fire?
choices: Harry, did you put your name in the Goblet of Fire?
Harry, did you confound the Goblet?
questions.note: He barks it in the film. Harry says he didn't.

questions.question: Tom Riddle says Voldemort is his past, his present, and his what?
questions.note: Chamber of Secrets, as the letters of Tom Marvolo Riddle rearrange into 'I am Lord Voldemort.'
